table.Statement: CREATE TABLE user (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, intt INTEGER, longg LONG, floatt FLOAT, doublee DOUBLE, decimall DECIMAL, booll BOOL, address TEXT, name TEXT, datetimee TEXT)
CREATE TABLE customer (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, address TEXT)

alter.Statement: ALTER TABLE user ADD datetimee TEXT

index.Statement: CREATE INDEX flNameIDX ON user (intt, longg)

trigger.Statement: CREATE TRIGGER updateCustomer AFTER INSERT ON user BEGIN INSERT INTO customer (name, address) VALUES (new.name, new.address); END;

insert.Statement: INSERT INTO user (intt, longg, floatt, doublee, decimall, booll, address, name, datetimee) VALUES(@intt, @longg, @floatt, @doublee, @decimall, @booll, @address, @name, @datetimee)

select.Statement: SELECT * FROM user WHERE doublee = @p0 LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM user WHERE doublee = @doublee LIMIT 50

update.Statement: UPDATE lastQuestionLocation SET topicQuestionId=@p0 WHERE memberId = @p1 AND topicID = @p2
